baseline_type: pre-change inventory plus historical saved snapshot

split_leakage_check.policy: SHA-256 of case-folded whitespace-normalized transcript; digest only

saved_stage_a_output.provenance: results/stage_a_output.json; pre-existing snapshot, not regenerated; entity counts differ from Git HEAD extractor replay

reproducible_comparison.policy: Same 270 records, same current verifier, same local cache, external HTTP blocked; only extractor source differs (Git HEAD versus working tree). This isolates extraction changes and is not a full before/after verification comparison.

evaluation_limits: Ground truth identifies injected error type, entity string, and correct value per affected record; it does not provide complete entity spans or annotations for all entity categories.
Entity-level precision, recall, and F1 cannot be computed reliably from the available labels.
Existing evaluator's localized injection coverage and clean-record false-positive measures are task-specific funnel metrics, not entity extraction accuracy.
evaluation_notes: The historical output snapshot has the same IDs and transcript hashes as the current evaluation set but its entity counts differ from a replay of Git HEAD source; it is retained for provenance and not used as the controlled comparison.
The controlled evaluator reports record-level injected-error funnel metrics only. It cannot establish entity precision/recall.
